name: NTR Mobile
source:
NTRMobile is a NTR roleplaying game where you are the protagonist, who is experiencing everything on your new mobile phone. While you are messing around getting your new phone in order, a pervert has his eyes on your girlfriend Liz. Work to earn money and unlock more tools to help you battle this pervert. Or use the tools to just be an observer and accept both of your fates. Your best friend Richard is always by your side to help you out. You can also live in complete ignorance while all kinds of depravity goes on behind your back. The choice is yours...

[From [url=https://nosyfellow.itch.io/ntr-mobile]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
NTRMobile是一款NTR角色扮演游戏，你是主角，在你的新手机上体验一切。当你忙着整理你的新手机时，一个变态盯上了你的女朋友莉兹。努力赚钱并解锁更多工具来帮助你对抗这个变态。或者使用这些工具只是成为一个观察者并接受你们的命运。你最好的朋友理查德总是在你身边帮助你。你也可以生活在完全无知中，而各种堕落却在你背后进行。选择权是你的…

[来自[url=https://nosyfellow.itch.io/ntr-mobile]Itch.io[/url]]
